items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I know Willie the Lion Smith; I know him very well.

ctx.x: We played down at Cafe Society together.
I know Willie the Lion Smith; I know him very well.
Willie the Lion Smith - we worked - I don't know, can't anybody play with Willie the Lion. But we had three piano players, three boogie-woogies, down at Cafe Society.
